guardMessageLines: [boot] AUTH_SECRET is required in production: without it, session cookies are signed with a public fallback constant — anyone could forge sessions. Generate one with "openssl rand -hex 32" and set it in the environment (see DEPLOYMENT.md §4).

devBootWarnLine: [boot] AUTH_SECRET is not set — using the insecure dev-only fallback. Set a real secret (openssl rand -hex 32) before deploying (DEPLOYMENT.md §4).
